scope: One read-only diagnosis of public completed AIDE/L3 outcomes and ordinary current source/configuration metadata. No source review reopening, experiment, new criterion or product completion.

answer.existingRoute: A reusable variant/development/selection/final/application engine exists and has genuine bounded outcomes. It is not merely a set of process-success demonstrations.
answer.remainingGap: A fresh host-bound agent/harness round is not a recurring registered target on that engine. Current coverage is three utility components, one narrow context-selection method, and one exact saved-helper target. A new agent-control round still needs operator-prepared source/development/final/release bindings and, where required, separately admitted real task-answer evidence.
answer.claimLimit: The inspected evidence does not establish a recurring unattended general agent/harness improvement cycle. This does not revoke L3.4-L3.7 or require repeating any closed context/helper experiment.

alreadyWorks.finding: ContextB passed an independent fixed final assessment: zero hard/relevance/correctness regressions and one newly answerable task with a direct-answer win; this was a real bounded agent-context quality improvement.
The exact Eva-authored contextB source was applied by the managed route and independently read back.

The following admitted L3.7 pass used the actual best installed source and earlier experience, stopped without an unnecessary new variant, and did not repeat application. It explicitly did not demonstrate a second optimization/promotion cycle.
The saved helper was independently improved: fractional cases 0/12 to 12/12 with all preservation cases retained and zero regressions; exact new source was saved and designated.
A later ordinary task resolved and executed that exact improved source without new implementation, and its physical result was independently read back.
Current source connects authorized native initiative work to the existing digital queue and component/programming actions. This diagnosis performs no new native usefulness or delivery check.

concreteSourceConstraints: Installed-code evaluator allowlisting and importer allowlisting are separate. The importer permits a context-body change only; adding a client path alone cannot create a safe general harness application route.
configured_final_assessments constructs multiple path-specific assessors in the existing service, so a second final register/daemon is unnecessary.

The current protocols and assessors are keyed by path, with one active configuration per path. A registration is deliberately consumed once; this is a protection against final-feedback optimization, not a defect to reset.

For ordinary installed-code paths, a freshly configured registration can coexist with retained terminal receipts in the existing receipt root, provided its exact baseline, assessor and publication references are current. This is source-level capability, not a new live-cycle claim.

For saved targets, startup revalidates even retained terminal packages against the current path protocol. Replacing that protocol/target under the same path would invalidate old receipt loading; prior round bindings must remain available for their own jobs.

HostFinalAssessment accepts separately admitted answer evidence through its existing answer_evidence_file/complete stage. It does not itself generate a general live agent-harness answer comparison. Isolated execution alone does not prove better agent behavior.
The existing repository chooser accepts only proven failed declarative checks from a bounded fixture repository; its availability is not proof of current live agent/harness evaluation coverage.

smallestNextDevelopmentTask.input: One real current agent-control deficit or explicit admitted extension, the actual current source baseline and permitted source boundary, current actor/project/mandate and provider/model profile, fixed development suite, separately registered independent final assessment and current release/application baseline.

Compose the admitted target and its fixed DevelopmentAssessment through the existing component_suites mapping.

existingModuleResponsibilities.adapters/postgres/component_improvement_: Use existing draft/compare/prepare lineage and current dispatch authority; include a host-bound round reference only if needed to distinguish same-path registrations.
existingModuleResponsibilities.operations/component_final_assessment.py: Keep the existing dispatcher. Bind each queued job to its original registration/assessor; load a fresh active round without replacing the consumed original protocol, protected inputs or retained receipts. Multiple paths are already supported.
existingModuleResponsibilities.operations/component_release_publisher.p: Admit only the specifically reviewed agent-control source boundary and use the fresh current integration/image baseline for exact accepted application.
existingModuleResponsibilities.adapters/model/pydantic_conversation.py: Offer only safe active-round metadata to native initiative selection and admit work through the existing live owner/mandate/profile/stop checks and queue.
